Description: Redirect the production www host to the canonical apex while preserving the public listener default forward and reversible cutover routing.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: The Cognito client and application origin guard use the apex; direct www login cannot retain the callback flow.
must: Match only www.tracepointhq.com on the pinned production HTTPS listener.
Preserve path/query and redirect only to the HTTPS apex.
Do not alter the listener default forward or shadow/rehearsal rules.
Use temporary HTTP_302 so stack deletion reverses routing without a permanently cached redirect.
